title: HELIX TransferCredit Resource
description: Credit earned at another institution and accepted for transfer. Links the external course to the equivalent internal course and tracks how the credit applies.

institution_id.description: HELIX ID of the receiving (current) institution

source_institution_name.description: Name of the institution where credit was earned

source_institution_id.description: HELIX ID of the source institution if registered, or external ID (FICE, OPEID, CEEB)

source_term.description: Term/period at the source institution when the course was taken

equivalent_course_ref.description: HELIX ID of the equivalent Course at the receiving institution. Null if accepted as elective.

credit_hours_accepted.description: Credit hours accepted at the receiving institution (may differ from source)

applies_to.description: How the transfer credit applies to the student's degree requirements

counts_toward_gpa.description: Whether transfer credit is included in the institutional GPA calculation

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource

ferpa_flags.description: FERPA enforcement flags, applied at Bronze->Silver identity resolution and checked by every consumer before disclosure. See govern/ferpa-disclosure-framework.json.

is_education_record.description: True if this record is a FERPA education record (34 CFR 99.3).

disclosure_basis_required.description: If true, a consumer must assert a valid 34 CFR 99.31 disclosure basis (or hold 99.30 consent) before data is returned.

directory_restricted.description: True when the student has an active directory-information opt-out (from FERPARestriction.restrict_directory). When true, NO directory information may be disclosed under the 99.31(a)(11) directory exception.

restricted_categories.description: Specific directory-information categories the student restricted (99.37). A field in this list must be withheld even if directory_restricted is false.

legitimate_interest_scope.description: Roles/purposes pre-authorized as school officials with legitimate educational interest for this record (drives the 99.31(a)(1) check).

study_disclosure_allowed.description: Whether this record may be released under a 99.31(a)(6) studies agreement (typically de-identified or under a written agreement).

helix_meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource
